properties.notes: Land allocated in Local Plan Part 2 for residential development. Canal & River Trust requires the following to be addressed at Technical Details Consent stage: structural integrity of the retaining wall to the canal, impact on lock nos.52&53 and by-wash, site layout to provide a positive waterside frontage, construction traffic over bridge no. 100 and need for a Construction Management Plan, ecologcial assessment, land contamination & pollution prevention to the canal, towpath improvements.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
